name: AQSH 10Y obligatsiya
text: AQSH 10Y obligatsiya (US10Y) 2026-10-29 yopilishida 4.9890. Kunlik o'rtacha harakat (ATR) 0.07917 (1.59%).
Bozor tuzilmasi: ko'tarilish (oxirgi cho'qqi 5.3640, oxirgi tub 4.9390).
Supportlar: 4.9325 (2 marta tegilgan, -1.1%); 4.7465 (2 marta tegilgan, -4.9%); 4.7005 (2 marta tegilgan, -5.8%).
Oxirgi 5 kunda datasetdagi strategiyalardan birortasi ham signal bermagan.
ATLAS deep learning prognozi: 5 savdo kunida median +0.67%, 90% oraliq 4.7993–5.2358, o'sish ehtimoli 57%.
Xulosa: ko'tarilish tomoni ustun (ishonch: kuchli, umumiy ball +0.65). Kuzatiladigan darajalar: 4.9325.
